title: Generation music
description: A background-music track, 10 to 120 seconds, made by the generation server.
pick_when: Background music or a song for a video, up to 2 minutes, paid in provider credits.

labels.1:value: Genre, mood, tempo, instruments and the scene. For a song add the lyrics and the vocal style.

hints: Made by the generation server on the provider, priced by its length and the length of its prompt.
Normally the length of the video it scores.
